QUIZHACK ARENA • PLAYER GUIDE

📖 How to Play — Complete Tutorial

Learn HTML and CSS, compete safely with classmates, defeat Cyber Titan, earn fictional XEO, and personalize your profile.

🧠 1. Quiz Arena & Quick Match

Practice HTML and CSS questions in Quiz Arena. Read the explanation after answering and review missed questions. Quick Match is solo practice, not a multiplayer room: you can leave Quick Match to join Multiplayer or Cyber Boss without a forfeit. The learning bank includes 375 curriculum questions; questions seen and missed are tracked where supported by your saved progress.

⚔️ 2. Real-Time Multiplayer

Enter a player name, select Create Room to get a code, or Join Room with a classmate's code. Rooms support 2–7 players. Mark yourself ready, answer match questions, and watch the synchronized timer, scores, firewall and standings. An inactive player may forfeit; a match with no active participants must not award an inactivity-only Champion. Do not join a second competitive match while you are active in one.

⚡ 3. Glitch Attacks & CSS Defense

Wrong answers can earn game-only Glitch Tokens. Spend a token to send a simulated Glitch Packet to another student. When attacked, open the CSS defense challenge and answer before the server-controlled 15-second deadline. Glitch effects change fictional game firewall values only; no real device or network is attacked.

👾 4. Cyber Titan Boss Arena

Join the weekly cooperative Cyber Boss challenge with 2–7 students. Correct answers help your team damage Cyber Titan while you protect the shared team firewall. Boss HP and the match clock are synchronized through Supabase. If everyone becomes inactive, Cyber Titan wins; an inactive team does not receive a victory. While active in Cyber Boss, you cannot also enter competitive Multiplayer or solo Quiz Arena.

🪙 5. Earn and Spend XEO

XEO is fictional in-game currency. The displayed earning rules are +15 XEO per correct multiplayer HTML answer, +25 XEO for successful CSS defense, +50 XEO for completing ten match questions, and +75 XEO for first place, subject to the installed Supabase rewards migration. Spend your wallet balance on cosmetics and eligible upgrades; simulated crypto-market trading does not generate spendable XEO.

🏎️ 6. Mystery Car Showroom & My Garage

Open the cosmetics area and select the garage. The Car Showroom displays all eight cars, but locked cars are deliberately shown as mystery previews. After purchase, the full car is revealed in My Garage in the matching fixed slot. Buying a car does not automatically equip it; choose Equip from your owned car. Unowned garage slots stay empty. Cars are cosmetic only and give no competitive advantage.

❓ 11. Frequently Asked Questions — XP, XEO & Game Rules

Select a question to see its answer. This guide does not change your wallet, progress, or match results.

⭐ XP = Experience Points

Measures learning and helps you level up.

🪙 XEO = In-Game Currency

Spend it on eligible upgrades and cosmetic items.

🏆 Match score = Competition result

Used to compare performance during a match; it is not your XEO wallet.

What is XP?

XP means Experience Points. It tracks your learning and player progression; it is not money.

What is XEO?

XEO is fictional in-game currency used for eligible purchases, including cosmetic cars and upgrades.

What is the difference between XP and XEO?

XP measures experience and progression. XEO is the wallet balance you can spend. Buying an item with XEO does not spend XP.

How do I increase my level?

Earn XP from activities that award experience. Your level increases when you reach the next required XP threshold.

How can I earn XEO?

Eligible multiplayer rewards include 15 XEO per correct HTML answer, 25 XEO for successful CSS defense, 50 XEO for completing ten match questions, and 75 XEO for first place, subject to the installed server reward rules.

Do simulated crypto trades earn spendable XEO?

No. The fictional crypto market is a learning simulation; its trading results do not create spendable XEO.

What are Firewall points?

Firewall is your fictional defensive strength in game challenges. Glitch attacks and defenses can change it; no real device is affected.

What is a Glitch Token?

A Glitch Token is a game-only attack resource that can be earned after a wrong answer in supported modes and used to send a simulated Glitch Packet.

How much time do I have to defend?

The CSS defense challenge has a server-controlled 15-second deadline.

What is a streak?

A streak tracks consecutive successful activity where supported. Streak Shield is a shop upgrade intended to protect one missed answer.

Is Quick Match multiplayer?

No. Quick Match is solo practice, and you may leave it to join a multiplayer room or Cyber Titan Boss without a forfeit.

Can I play two competitive matches at once?

No. A player should have only one active competitive match at a time.

What happens if everyone is inactive?

An inactivity-only multiplayer match should not award a Champion. In Cyber Titan Boss, if everyone is inactive, Cyber Titan wins.

Why is a showroom car partly hidden?

Locked cars use mystery previews. Once you buy a car, My Garage reveals its complete image in its matching slot.

Does buying a car equip it automatically?

No. After purchase, open My Garage and choose Equip. The starter Street Sprint is free.

Do cars improve my quiz scores?

No. Cars are cosmetic collectibles and do not provide a competitive advantage.

Will equipping another car remove my owned car?

No. Equipping changes the selected car; owned cars remain in their fixed garage slots.

What are achievement badges?

Badges recognize accomplishments such as correct answers, successful defenses, perfect matches, and multiplayer victories.

What does the leaderboard measure?

It shows game progress and competitive standings according to the installed ranking rules; XP, XEO, and match score are different measurements.

Does the game use real money or hack real computers?

No. XEO, simulated cryptocurrency, firewall, and glitch attacks are fictional educational mechanics.

Safety: All hacking, firewall, XEO, cryptocurrency, and attack mechanics are fictional educational simulations. QuizHack Arena does not attack real computers or involve real-money cryptocurrency.
